description: Configure Jest test runner to handle flaky tests. You must: (1) Modify 'jest.config.js' in /home/ga/workspace/flaky-test-project/ to add retry configuration - add a 'retries: 2' field or configure jest-retries or similar retry mechanism. (2) In 'tests/api.test.js': (a) Find the test named 'fetchUserData returns user object' and increase its timeout from 5000ms to at least 10000ms by changing the third parameter of the test() call, (b) Find the test named 'processWebhook handles payload' and add retry logic using jest.retryTimes(2) before the test or this.retries(2) inside the test or similar retry annotation, (c) Add at least one console.log statement in one of the tests that logs 'Attempt' or 'retry' to track retry attempts. (3) Create a new file 'FLAKY_TESTS.md' in /home/ga/workspace/flaky-test-project/ that documents: the flaky test names (fetchUserData and/or processWebhook), mentions the retry strategy, and includes the current date. The file should be at least 50 characters long. Save all modified files.
